As Featured On:

Our most powerful solar generator is back — and you can take a whole year to pay.

When a freak storm hits or the aging grid collapses, you are the only one you can count on to keep your family warm, connected, and safe. One day of backup is not enough. You need power that can last for days.

Earlier this year, Winter Storm Fern knocked out power from New Mexico to New York. Then this summer, our July 4th sale became the biggest holiday promotion in 4Patriots history… and it sold the NEW Patriot Power Generator 2200X clean out. At one point, 2,932 generators were on backorder, and it took us more than two weeks to catch up.

Demand is surging, and the folks in our warehouse are working overtime to ship fast. Your generator ships in 7–10 days. And on this page, you get it at our storm-season price — with a FREE 200-watt solar panel and a FREE Roll & Go Cart.

We took everything customers loved about our top-selling solar generators over the last decade… and we made it better. It holds 39% more battery capacity than our previous model, recharges from a wall outlet in about 1.5–1.8 hours, and its upgraded battery is rated for 4,000 lifecycles (about 11 years of daily cycling).

Your backup should not depend on the same gas everyone else needs.

Gas backup can fail you during an emergency for one simple reason: it needs the same gas everyone else is lining up for. The 2200X stores indoor-safe power ahead of time, then refills from the sun, or from a wall outlet when power comes back on.

That’s why your FREE 200-watt solar panel matters. When the grid is down, the sun refills your generator. No gas can. No gas line. No gas station. No engine. No pull cord.
